793template <typename T>
794T &Vec<T>::front() noexcept {
795 assert(!this->empty());
796 return (*this)[0];
797}
798
799template <typename T>
800T &Vec<T>::back() noexcept {
801 assert(!this->empty());
802 return (*this)[this->size() - 1];
803}
804
805template <typename T>
806void Vec<T>::reserve(std::size_t new_cap) {
807 this->reserve_total(new_cap);
808}
809
810template <typename T>
811void Vec<T>::push_back(const T &value) {
812 this->emplace_back(value);
813}
814
815template <typename T>
816void Vec<T>::push_back(T &&value) {
817 this->emplace_back(std::move(value));
818}
819
820template <typename T>
821template <typename... Args>
822void Vec<T>::emplace_back(Args &&...args) {
823 auto size = this->size();
824 this->reserve_total(size + 1);
825 ::new (reinterpret_cast<T *>(reinterpret_cast<char *>(this->data()) +
826 size * size_of<T>()))
827 T(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
828 this->set_len(size + 1);
829}
830
831template <typename T>
832void Vec<T>::clear() {
833 this->truncate(0);
834}
835
836template <typename T>
837typename Vec<T>::iterator Vec<T>::begin() noexcept {
838 return Slice<T>(this->data(), this->size()).begin();
839}
840
841template <typename T>
842typename Vec<T>::iterator Vec<T>::end() noexcept {
843 return Slice<T>(this->data(), this->size()).end();
844}
845
846template <typename T>
847typename Vec<T>::const_iterator Vec<T>::begin() const noexcept {
848 return this->cbegin();
849}
850
851template <typename T>
852typename Vec<T>::const_iterator Vec<T>::end() const noexcept {
853 return this->cend();
854}
855
856template <typename T>
857typename Vec<T>::const_iterator Vec<T>::cbegin() const noexcept {
858 return Slice<const T>(this->data(), this->size()).begin();
859}
860
861template <typename T>
862typename Vec<T>::const_iterator Vec<T>::cend() const noexcept {
863 return Slice<const T>(this->data(), this->size()).end();
864}
865
866template <typename T>
867void Vec<T>::swap(Vec &rhs) noexcept {
868 using std::swap;
869 swap(this->repr, rhs.repr);
870}
871
872template <typename T>
873Vec<T>::Vec(unsafe_bitcopy_t, const Vec &bits) noexcept : repr(bits.repr) {}
874#endif // CXXBRIDGE1_RUST_VEC

898#ifndef CXXBRIDGE1_LAYOUT
899#define CXXBRIDGE1_LAYOUT
900class layout {
901 template <typename T>
902 friend std::size_t size_of();
903 template <typename T>
904 friend std::size_t align_of();
905 template <typename T>
906 static typename std::enable_if<std::is_base_of<Opaque, T>::value,
907 std::size_t>::type
908 do_size_of() {
909 return T::layout::size();
910 }
911 template <typename T>
912 static typename std::enable_if<!std::is_base_of<Opaque, T>::value,
913 std::size_t>::type
914 do_size_of() {
915 return sizeof(T);
916 }
917 template <typename T>
918 static
919 typename std::enable_if<detail::is_complete<T>::value, std::size_t>::type
920 size_of() {
921 return do_size_of<T>();
922 }
923 template <typename T>
924 static typename std::enable_if<std::is_base_of<Opaque, T>::value,
925 std::size_t>::type
926 do_align_of() {
927 return T::layout::align();
928 }
929 template <typename T>
930 static typename std::enable_if<!std::is_base_of<Opaque, T>::value,
931 std::size_t>::type
932 do_align_of() {
933 return alignof(T);
934 }
935 template <typename T>
936 static
937 typename std::enable_if<detail::is_complete<T>::value, std::size_t>::type
938 align_of() {
939 return do_align_of<T>();
940 }
941};
942
943template <typename T>
944std::size_t size_of() {
945 return layout::size_of<T>();
946}
947
948template <typename T>
949std::size_t align_of() {
950 return layout::align_of<T>();
951}
952#endif // CXXBRIDGE1_LAYOUT
953} // namespace cxxbridge1
954} // namespace rust
